Composition.description: The canonical score (brasscribe_music.score_model.Composition): concert pitch, integer ticks.
Composition.title: Composition

auth_required.description: whether this client must send a bearer token
auth_required.title: Auth Required

device.description: accelerator torch adapters use on this host: cuda, mps or cpu
device.title: Device

allow_heavy.description: allow heavy models to run on cache misses
allow_heavy.title: Allow Heavy

render_audio.description: also render an MP3 of the score
render_audio.title: Render Audio

start.description: ticks from the first downbeat (negative in a pickup)
start.title: Start

code.description: pairing code shown by the engine (brasscribe serve --host 0.0.0.0)
code.title: Code

token.description: send as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' on every request
token.title: Token

validated.description: checked end to end against a golden output
validated.title: Validated

cpu.description: runs on CPU from cached model outputs
cpu.title: Cpu

requires.description: data paths the suite reads, relative to the data directory
requires.title: Requires

info.description: Recording in, brass-band score out. Jobs run a profile's stage DAG with a content-addressed cache; progress streams as Server-Sent Events. Loopback clients are trusted; LAN clients pair with the code the engine prints and then send a bearer token.
info.title: brasscribe engine

post.description: Upload audio and start a job in one request (same as uploadAudio followed by createJob).

200.description: Composition JSON, byte for byte as written by the pipeline

schema.description: One Server-Sent Event payload (the `data:` line); `event:` carries `type`.

fraction.description: share of the job's stages done (stage events)
fraction.title: Fraction

schema.title: JobEvent

200.description: Server-Sent Events; each `data:` line is a JobEvent
